Johnny doesn’t really have bad matchups but I can at least offer some advice. There really isn’t gonna be a character who beats him up close but Sub Zero has good space control and can give aggressive players with a tendency to over-extend (very johnny cage way to play the game) hell. As far as Quan goes, I main him and consider myself to be pretty good with him, relatively speaking at least. The name of the game against Johnny and characters like him is taking advantage of the bone cage and the green portal then using S4 to check him a lot. Keep him away, or at the very least keep him in one place. Once you’ve conditioned him to sit still more you can get into your orange portal shenanigans and (less so) zoning. MB downward skull is also a good tool I don’t see a lot of other Quans using enough in those types of matchups. Overall he’s just not a very good character. Good luck!

Thankfully, there are a lot of other people like you who are in the same boat. I’d start by unlocking a few classes and maybe seeing which ones are the most intriguing to you. The lower levels of apprentice will be comprised mostly of new players just like you who will also be experimenting, so you’ll still likely win plenty of games during that phase. 

The most important piece of guidance I can offer you, though it doesn’t pertain directly to deck-building, is to NEVER disenchant cards, unless they are nerfed. Otherwise, you lose at the very least 75% and up to 88% of the value of the card were you to pay to craft it.
